facts.text: The trading desks live in ~/Desktop/MAIN2026; never reset its shared folder.
An HTML file for the Desktop needs a charset line, or Safari shows wrong characters.
Commit and push only when the user says so.
Make a backup before moving or deleting many files.
Reports are delivered as one self-contained HTML file.
Run the tests with `bun run test`; a bare `bun test` is not recorded.
Every page about Bonsai is saved in the 'bonsai-code DOCS' folder.
Run `bun run docs` before each commit to mirror the DOCS folder.
The terminal imports the models part only through models/index.mjs.
The 27B's settings, such as sampling and context, are in models/bonsai-2-27b/model.mjs.
The bug-fixing rules are in terminal/rules/bug-fixing.md.
Install the command line app with `bun run install-cli`.
Only one 27B fits in memory on the 16 GB Mac, so bench runs wait for each other.
Raw test results stay in models/<model>/results and are not in git.
Worked: the symbol list showed again after lowering the legend's z-index in legend.js.
Failed: raising the z-index of #sym-menu did not bring the symbol list above the legend.
In app tests, text left in the prompt needs one more ctrl+c before the app quits.
The night test run is started with models/evals/bench/night/start.sh.
The hub's Tests tab reads ~/.bonsai-code/tests/record.jsonl.
A file longer than the reply limit must be written in parts, not in one Write.
